QUOTE: **Default (opt-out not defined):** `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `private_##member`. ... **Opt-out defined:** the same macro expands to plain `member`, so the names are ordinary.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the default expands to `private_##member` (the rename) and that defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS makes it expand to the plain member name.
